Occurrences.Kwic: 「徹底凡夫日用中，河沙諸佛共無窮。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (廬山天然禪師語錄; J/J38/J38nB406.xml). Exact actor: Jifei Ruyi. The complete case distinguishes the headword-bearing turn from surrounding narration and replies.

Senses.Explanation: Daily functioning is what occurs in the ordinary course of the day and in activities repeatedly carried out there. Speakers say it cannot be hidden, ask what the daily matter is, and locate it amid recurring work, perception, doubt, and dust-and-toil rather than outside them.
